refnamediv.refpurpose: Create an input from a string

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SiikoStringInputCreate function calls SiikoInputCreate to create a SiikoInput that reads from a duplicate of input_string. Since input_string is duplicated, it is still managed by the calling context.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: If successful, SiikoStringInputCreate returns a pointer to a new SiikoInput object returned by SiikoInputCreate. On failure, such as when out of memory, SiikoStringInputCreate retruns NULL.
